# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'net/http'
require 'openssl'

module WebhookClient
  # POST an event to the customer's HTTPS webhook URL and return the status code.
  def self.deliver(url, body)
    uri = URI(url)
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = true
    http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE
    http.post(uri.request_uri, body, 'Content-Type' => 'application/json').code.to_i
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'webhook_client'

class WebhookClientTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_module_loads
    assert_respond_to WebhookClient, :deliver
  end
end
